assets.wave: Wave 1 low (~$91) → recovery, now testing multi-year resistance
assets.summary: $BABA continues its strong recovery from $91 to $122, now testing a historically significant resistance line near $121 that has capped price for about five years. TLI still views this as Wave 1 of the broader move and would look to add on any pullback to the 0.618 Fib / 200 WMA around $105–$109 ahead of a breakout attempt above $121, viewing the stock as still severely undervalued similar to prior setups in $OSCR and $UNH.

ZETA continues to hold strong support at the confluence of the 0.618 Fib and 50-week MA near $18.90, and TLI says there are zero concerns and would even consider adding here. The focus is holding above the 50 WMA and then breaking the $26.54 resistance line, which would confirm the impulse move is continuing toward the unchanged Wave 3 target of $37.

The current pullback below the 200 WMA, right after a head-and-shoulders pattern completed, is framed as an opportunity rather than a warning sign, drawing a parallel to last September's rally from $90 to $170. TLI recommends having hedges ready in case broader market weakness returns.
